visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a light blue short-sleeved button-down shirt with a name tag, black trousers, and glasses stands in a corridor with promotional banners. He holds a microphone and speaks, gesturing towards a group of people behind him. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a large stadium corridor with stacked boxes and promotional displays. The man is seen sitting alone on a chair looking pensive, then later walking through a crowded hallway where fans are gathered. (3) On a brightly lit stage with a purple floral backdrop, three women in white and red baseball-style cheerleader uniforms are posing. The man in the blue shirt joins them on stage, standing beside an MC wearing a red and white striped baseball jersey. (4) The group on stage participates in interactive activities, including placing their hands together in a huddle and dancing. Text overlays like '(?)' and '(不要)' appear to highlight comical moments. (5) In a more secluded hallway with stacked cardboard boxes, the man interacts and takes selfies with the women in cheerleader outfits and fans. He concludes by standing in front of a large product poster for Physiogel, holding a white cream tube.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: One main creator (A-Di), one MC, four cheerleaders (Lotte Girls), and approximately 10 various staff and crowd members.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a light blue short-sleeved school-style shirt with a name tag 'Ray' and black pants.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between a hallway with promotional banners for 'Valment' and 'Physiogel', a large indoor stadium corridor (Taipei Dome), and a dedicated event stage with a purple floral 'LG' backdrop. Stacks of 'LG' brand cardboard boxes are visible in some scenes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Casual conversation begins with a male voice speaking at a moderate pace and friendly tone, accompanied by a light, upbeat acoustic BGM. A female voice off-camera asks a question. (2) The acoustic texture shifts to a more reverberant stadium environment. Background noise floor increases with crowd chatter. The BGM remains but is joined by faint stadium music. (3) An MC's voice is heard through a PA system, characterized by a booming, high-intensity professional tone. Frequent cartoon-style sound effects (impacts, boings) are synced with text overlays. (4) Multiple female voices are heard laughing and chatting excitedly. The sound of multiple digital camera shutters clicking is present. (5) The primary male voice returns with high articulation clarity, speaking directly to the audience in a promotional tone. The BGM swells slightly before a final digital notification-like chime ends the clip.

temporal_pacing_summary.mainActionFlow: Intro commentary -> Event highlights and stage interactions -> Backstage fan/cheerleader interaction -> Final product endorsement.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comedic promotional Vlog for the skin care brand Physiogel. It uses the influencer A-Di's 'awkward' persona to create an entertaining narrative about his attendance as a brand ambassador at a high-profile event at the Taipei Dome alongside popular cheerleaders (Lotte Girls). The contrast between the glamorous cheerleaders and his self-deprecating humor aims to engage his audience while subtly showcasing the product.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of products, participation in a brand-sponsored event, final call-to-action regarding a sale at Cosmed (康是美), and 'Brand Ambassador' title.

social_sociology_tags.uniqueSignatures: Self-deprecating humor, variety-show style high-density text overlays, interaction with mainstream sports culture figures (cheerleaders).
social_sociology_tags.freeDescribe: The video leverages 'second-hand embarrassment' humor to drive engagement. The use of variety show editing techniques makes the commercial content more palatable to a younger social media audience.
